title: MessageBar
description: Communicates important information about the state of the entire application or surface. For example, the status of a page, panel, dialog or card. The information shouldn't require someone to take immediate action, but should persist until the user performs one of the required actions. > ⚠️ For `aria-live` announcements to work correctly you should configure you application with a > AriaLiveAnnouncer > towards the top of the React tree.
bestPractices:
## Best practices

### Do

- Use MessageBar components inside MesssageBarGroup
- Include a dismiss button as the container action
- Reduce number of actions in the MessageBar
- Use preset intents

### Don't

- Use enter animations on page load
- Use manual layout if possible - this is a built-in feature
- Use long messages for content - keep content to under 100 characters
- Customize announcement politeness - check with your a11y champ
